folds.heading: ### Book UI receipt qualifications B271
folds.body:
Full [13lane landing receipt](gm/dispatch/book-ui-wave-2026-10-30/LANDING_RECEIPT.md), [pathway-card checkpoint](gm/dispatch/book-ui-wave-2026-10-30/PATHWAY_CARD_CHECKPOINT.md) and [original-trial receipt](gm/dispatch/book-ui-wave-2026-10-30/evidence/ss/RECEIPT.md) were reviewed. Landing source, built artifacts, focused tests and a complete gameplay floor are distinct. The4797test suite ran before final lane tips; later83focused checks/arch/rules do not become a rerun of that suite. The c51c427de436bundle predates later master merges; dist/index remained uncommitted and partly held by another writer. Baseline-paired cast failures, the committed-versus-rebuilt stylesheet manifest and later lane CSS fixes preserve their actual input differences. No current commit, install, push, writer or bundle was revalidated.

The pathway card is a world-neutral read/render model with a real LOTM host-view proof page plus a synthetic second world. Its1920screens at14/21px and measured private art loading support that harness, not a native mounted game-shell journey. No art or private screenshot was opened or republished here. Current prose-first presentation keeps illustrations optional, not a required placeholder/portrait/glyph slot for every pane. The knownness ladder must not expose a hidden requirement's existence or count through anonymous locked rows unless the character actually knows that much; levels/families are a display model, not a source of knowledge (AR8, ABR19, PIR5). Route costs stay with actual known host actions; purchase/divination families in a model do not imply authored routes.

The checkpoint's floor labels are transposed: under [GROUND_RULES](GROUND_RULES.md#delivery-floor-flr1-flr6-accepted-as-ad43), FLR2 is Route, FLR3 Shown and FLR4 Used. Its own missing host mount/game-shell route/duplicate plan and linear-only graph limits remain explicit historical scope. The4728total/4720pass/5fail leaves three statuses unspecified in that paragraph; do not silently invent TODO/skipped values or treat the suite as all green. Seven card tests are within the17focused post-fix total, not24independent checks. The four remaining “environmental” failure explanations are explicitly inference there. A targeted current name search did not establish every indirect mount or present route; old no-mount text alone cannot prove current absence.

The original-trial receipt names a rebuilt bundle, fresh Beginning route, actual result consumer and save/reload/Export/Import. Preserve that finite authored original mode rather than call it a source-canon whole-life path. Its pre-edit MCP walk and reported post-edit desktop run remain separate evidence. The full suite was still running at the report timestamp and is not a live process or a pass now. WCO1carry-list/crossings-view remains separately unproved by that receipt, with observed unwanted centre auto-switch and duplicate generic refusal. Neither a successful ladder nor an unwired carry projection proves the other. Current AD36/AD42/AD43, actual file ownership and selected route govern further work; no runtime/UI change, host patch, build, test or new acceptance gate was selected.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B271
folds.body:
Full checkpoint reviewed with the13lane landing receipt and original-trial receipt. Preserve the authored requirement families, real-host proof-page states, synthetic second-world distinction, sparse authored routes and private-data boundaries. Current [floor definitions](../../../GROUND_RULES.md#delivery-floor-flr1-flr6-accepted-as-ad43) identify FLR2 as Route, FLR3 as Shown and FLR4 as Used; the earlier “FLR2 consumer / FLR4 browser” wording is a label error, not new floor authority. The actual disclosed missing host mount/game-shell proof remains distinct from a passing isolated card renderer.

The full-suite paragraph's4728total/4720pass/5fail does not account for three statuses in this record; their classification is unknown here. The17focused post-token-fix checks include the seven card cases. Environmental explanations remain inference, and no full suite was rerun here. Current prose-first direction keeps artwork optional. A locked row/family/count must not reveal the existence or shape of an actually unknown requirement merely because the read model can enumerate it (AR8, ABR19). A no-save-state card needs no new save slice; a later selected change to host state/commands still carries its own real persistence obligations. No private art/screenshot or current native host integration was inspected by proxy.
